proof_body:
by
  intro μ
  have h : ∀ c ∈ μ.cells, c.1 ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0) := by
    intro c hc
    have hc' : (c.1, c.2) ∈ μ := hc
    have : (c.1, 0) ∈ μ := μ.up_left_mem le_rfl (Nat.zero_le _) hc'
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (YoungDiagram.mem_iff_lt_colLen.mp this)
  rw [YoungDiagram.card, Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [YoungDiagram.rowLen_eq_card]
  rfl
target_source: ∀ μ : YoungDiagram, μ.card = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), μ.rowLen i
